question_summary: Request approval to substitute a linear slot diffuser in place of the specified perforated face diffuser per Section 23 82 00 due to lead times.
proposed_solution: Approve use of an alternate linear slot diffuser in lieu of the specified perforated face diffuser; cost-neutral and no impact to equipment delivery schedule.
deadline_text: A response within three business days would be appreciated.
routing_rationale: The Mechanical Engineer of Record must review HVAC air terminal substitutions for performance, compatibility, and code compliance; architectural input may be needed for appearance.
